revision: S5/P4 (user 2026-11-15): 6HP pure-analog filter. No MIDI / GATE / MCU / REC / ENV TIME / CURVE / VCA: 4 jacks, 3 pots, 2 LEDs. Inputs on top (IN + RES CV, then CV with its DEPTH knob beside it and the two CV LEDs, negative and positive, under DEPTH), CUTOFF and RES alone on the centre line as the main knobs, OUT at the bottom. S5: second CV LED (negative CV), resonance by an LM13700 OTA (SMD) instead of the vactrol, so no vactrol on B. THT parts placed, every SMD part parked off the board, unrouted. Replaces the 10HP S3/P2 panel and the R2 routed carrier.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: As modules/hats / modules/8bit (6HP): 30.0 mm wide, one hole pair at X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 + 1 HP). Skiff rails: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm, as modules/hats; held by the four jack nuts (RV09 pots take no nut). 4 layers as S3 (F signal / In1 GND / In2 power / B signal); the layer count can be revisited when routing starts. All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm board-edge keep-out (copper-edge rule 1.0 mm in the .kicad_pro).

panel_order: Top: IN, RES CV. Second row: CV jack (left) with its DEPTH knob (right); the two CV LEDs sit under DEPTH (- left, + right). Centre line: CUTOFF, RES (main knobs, one per row). Bottom: OUT. J10 upright on B at the right edge beside OUT.
layout_note: 6HP leaves 27 mm between the 1 mm edge keep-outs: two jacks or one jack + one pot per row (columns X7.95 / X22.05, as modules/8bit), or one part on the centre line X15.0. CUTOFF and RES stand alone on the centre line, 26 mm apart, so each takes a knob up to ~22 mm across; DEPTH is the small knob. Labels sit 12.5 mm above the main knob centres, 7.7 mm above the second row.
jack_note: Placed by the footprint origin = barrel = panel hole, all at rot 0 (courtyard X -4.75..+4.75, Y -6.25..+7.8). Row 1 Y17.5 (courtyard top Y11.25, 2.0 mm from the board edge), CV Y35.0, OUT Y110.4 (courtyard bottom Y118.2, 1.05 mm from the board edge).
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k linear (user stock), vertical snap-in, tall knurled shaft, no bushing, no nut, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint (as modules/hats / modules/acid)
pot_note: All pots upright (pins 7.5 mm below the shaft; courtyard X -6.41..+6.41, Y -5.10..+8.65 from the shaft). DEPTH courtyard X15.64..28.46 (1.04 mm from the right board edge), Y29.90..43.65. CUTOFF Y58.90..72.65, RES Y84.90..98.65: 12.25 mm between them (free on both sides since S5), 5.5 mm from RES to the OUT jack courtyard (Y104.15).
led_note: 3 mm THT on F at rotation 0 (pads side by side, cathode pad 1 on the left, anode pad 2 on the right), placed by the pad centre = body centre; side by side under the DEPTH knob, 5.5 mm apart, centred on its column X22.05 (CV jack -> DEPTH -> LEDs -> CUTOFF): D12 (negative CV) left, D11 (positive CV) right, marked - and + on the panel. Courtyards Y44.29..48.71 (DEPTH courtyard ends Y43.65, CUTOFF starts Y58.90); the nearer LED is 18.0 mm from the CUTOFF shaft, clear of a 22 mm knob. Domes flush with the panel front as modules/8bit / modules/hats.

stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit / modules/hats (Z0 = carrier F.Cu; PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear at 10.0 mm; LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front).

power_header.orientation: Upright at the right edge beside the OUT jack (as modules/8bit / modules/12bit), rot 180 on B: odd pins on the inner column X23.8, even pins on X26.34; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom Y114.38, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top Y104.22. Courtyard X22.03..28.11 (1.39 mm from the right edge), Y102.45..116.15 (3.1 mm from the bottom edge).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. It covers no pot or jack pad (RES right lug ends Y91.6, X21.16); a 10-pin socket spans Y100.41..118.19. The socket underside sits 2.5 mm above B on the header plastic: B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: right edge beside OUT, upright, rot 180 on B: pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).
